messages.author: 7a7ed0e90c88eb35
messages.subject: species identification
parts:
This may be a stupid question, but do I have to go through each directory and tag the species ID itself or is there a way for me to tag some of them and the program to go through and find the others
On the other hand is their a way for me to pull up only images that were taken when the motion detector was stimulated so that I can quickly id species?
Thanks

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: species identification
parts:
Currently there is no automatic species identification implemented in camtrapR or digiKam. digiKam can search for similar images (in the fuzzy search), but I never tried it. I suppose it will be rather unreliable with normal camera trapping photos.
digiKam has lots of filtering options, and I believe it should be possible to filter only the images in which the motion detector was activated (filters are in the bar on the very right). I unfortunately don't have digiKam installed at the moment and can't check for you.
